header.messageTitle: Cash deposit instructions for certain softwood lumber product from Canada (A-122-857)

messages.text:
1.  Commerce has published in the Federal Register (85 FR 76519) on 11/30/2020 the final results of its administrative review of certain producers and/or exporters subject to the antidumping duty order on certain softwood lumber from Canada for the period 06/30/2017 through 12/31/2018.

2.  As a result of Commerce's review, the cash deposit rates have been revised for certain companies.
